con:interface.name: Bearer Authentication API
con:interface.con:description: Stateful authentication contract for the banking workflow example. Login creates a session. Refresh rotates both tokens, invalidating the old refresh token and access token atomically. The session ID stays unchanged. Logout revokes the entire session, including every token issued for it. Examples are synthetic, nonfunctional fixtures, not credentials. This file does not deploy a service. Configure an isolated implementation or stateful mock; static auto-mocking does not implement these semantics.

con:part.con:content: openapi: 3.0.3 info: title: Bearer Authentication API version: 2.0.0 description: | Stateful authentication contract for the banking workflow example. Login creates a session. Refresh rotates both tokens, invalidating the old refresh token and access token atomically. The session ID stays unchanged. Logout revokes the entire session, including every token issued for it. Examples are synthetic, nonfunctional fixtures, not credentials. This file does not deploy a service. Configure an isolated implementation or stateful mock; static auto-mocking does not implement these semantics. servers: - url: http://localhost:8081 description: Isolated authentication test service; must be supplied separately tags: - name: authentication paths: /login: post: operationId: loginUser tags: [authentication] summary: Create a session and issue access and refresh tokens security: [] requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/LoginRequest' example: username: demo-user password: not-a-real-password responses: '200': description: Session created content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/TokenResponse' example: access_token: synthetic-access-token-1 refresh_token: synthetic-refresh-token-1 token_type: Bearer expires_in: 300 session_id: session-demo-1 '400': $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest' '401': description: Invalid credentials content: application/problem+json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' example: type: urn:banking:error:invalid-credentials title: Invalid credentials status: 401 code: INVALID_CREDENTIALS detail: The username or password is incorrect. /refresh: post: operationId: refreshSession tags: [authentication] summary: Rotate tokens for an active session description: | Accepts a valid, unused refresh token, including when its access token has expired. Returns new access and refresh tokens for the same session. Both old tokens become invalid. A refresh token is single-use; a replay returns INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN. Revoked sessions return SESSION_REVOKED. Clients must not blindly retry refresh after an ambiguous network failure. security: [] requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/RefreshRequest' example: refresh_token: synthetic-refresh-token-1 responses: '200': description: Tokens rotated atomically content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/TokenResponse' example: access_token: synthetic-access-token-2 refresh_token: synthetic-refresh-token-2 token_type: Bearer expires_in: 300 session_id: session-demo-1 '400': $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest' '401': description: Invalid refresh token or revoked session content: application/problem+json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' examples: invalidRefreshToken: value: type: urn:banking:error:invalid-refresh-token title: Invalid refresh token status: 401 code: INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN detail: The refresh token is expired, invalid, or already used. revokedSession: value: type: urn:banking:error:session-revoked title: Session revoked status: 401 code: SESSION_REVOKED detail: The session has been revoked. /logout: post: operationId: logoutUser tags: [authentication] summary: Revoke a session and all its tokens description: | The body token must be the current refresh token. A valid refresh token permits cleanup even if the access token has expired. A first successful logout returns 204 with no response body. Already revoked sessions return 401 SESSION_REVOKED. Invalid or rotated tokens return INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN. security: [] requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: type: object additionalProperties: false required: [token] properties: token: type: string minLength: 1 description: Current refresh token, not the access token responses: '204': description: Session revoked; no response body '400': $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest' '401': description: Invalid refresh token or already revoked session content: application/problem+json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' examples: revokedSession: value: type: urn:banking:error:session-revoked title: Session revoked status: 401 code: SESSION_REVOKED detail: The session has already been revoked. invalidRefreshToken: value: type: urn:banking:error:invalid-refresh-token title: Invalid refresh token status: 401 code: INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN detail: Supply the latest refresh token. components: schemas: LoginRequest: type: object additionalProperties: false required: [username, password] properties: username: type: string minLength: 1 password: type: string format: password minLength: 1 writeOnly: true RefreshRequest: type: object additionalProperties: false required: [refresh_token] properties: refresh_token: type: string minLength: 1 TokenResponse: type: object additionalProperties: false required: [access_token, refresh_token, token_type, expires_in, session_id] properties: access_token: type: string minLength: 1 refresh_token: type: string minLength: 1 token_type: type: string enum: [Bearer] expires_in: type: integer minimum: 1 description: Access-token lifetime in seconds session_id: type: string minLength: 1 Problem: type: object required: [type, title, status, code, detail] properties: type: type: string format: uri title: type: string status: type: integer enum: [400, 401] code: type: string enum: [INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_CREDENTIALS, INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN, SESSION_REVOKED] detail: type: string responses: BadRequest: description: Missing or invalid request fields content: application/problem+json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' example: type: urn:banking:error:invalid-request title: Invalid request status: 400 code: INVALID_REQUEST detail: A required field is missing or invalid.
